column1: # STATUS: LIVE, 2026-11-20 (task I7; docs/design/V3_GUEST_INGRESS_TABLE.md section 5). REVIEWED LIST.
# Ids the generated guest-ingress gate admits at a tag where the pre-I7 gate refused them. Read only by
# crates/kf-rm/tests/ingress_parity.rs (never by the generator): any other such id fails that test. Each row
# needs: the ogkm flag (NON_PRIVILEGED at the tag) or the Mode2Rpc reason, kayfabe serving it, and why the old gate
# refused it. The four rows of 2026-11-24 (security review of PR #545, F1) widen nothing a guest reaches: the channel
# link served these ids without asking either gate; it now asks, and the table admits them by name.
